# Fix assigner change via assign HC

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

Our current `assign` host call implementation is broken. It disregards the assigner permision switch. This PR fixes that and also improves the documentation of that code paths.

## Walkthrough

This pull request refactors the authorization queue management system to use per-core assigners instead of direct authorization values. Register 8 in `bless.ts` is reinterpreted as a memory pointer to assigners, and the corresponding variable names are updated (`authorizers` → `assigners`). The `mergePrivilegedServices` function in `accumulation-result-merge-utils.ts` is restructured with early returns and sequential role-based override blocks. The `updateAuthorizationQueue` method in `accumulate-externalities.ts` is updated to work with per-core assigners and compare against the current service ID. Comprehensive test coverage is added for authorization queue updates, including self-transfer and transfer semantics validation.
